SELECT APPROVAL_HISTORY_SEQ.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO APPROVAL_HISTORY ( HISTORY_ID, DOC_ID, APPROVER_ID, APPROVAL_ORDER, ACTION, COMMENT_TEXT, ACTION_AT ) VALUES ( #{historyId}, #{docId}, #{approverId}, #{approvalOrder}, #{action}, #{commentText, jdbcType=CLOB}, #{actionAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT HISTORY_ID, DOC_ID, APPROVER_ID, APPROVAL_ORDER, ACTION, COMMENT_TEXT, ACTION_AT FROM APPROVAL_HISTORY WHERE DOC_ID = #{docId} AND ACTION = 'PENDING' ORDER BY APPROVAL_ORDER ASC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

SELECT AH.HISTORY_ID, AH.DOC_ID, AH.APPROVER_ID, AH.APPROVAL_ORDER, AH.ACTION, AH.COMMENT_TEXT, AH.ACTION_AT, U.NAME AS APPROVER_NAME, U.RANK AS APPROVER_RANK FROM APPROVAL_HISTORY AH JOIN USERS U ON AH.APPROVER_ID = U.ID WHERE AH.DOC_ID = #{docId} AND AH.APPROVAL_ORDER = #{currentOrder} + 1 ORDER BY AH.APPROVAL_ORDER ASC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
